items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: And Lelke was there. And Pinky was there. And they kept Lelke because they only had four or five people.

ctx.x: Well, it had to be before 34. Before 34. Yeah, yeah. Because 32, when the banks closed. When the banks closed. Really? About 32. About 32. When the banks closed. We stayed there, but we didn't stay too much longer. And Lelke was there. And Pinky was there. And they kept Lelke because they only had four or five people. And they let Pinky go.
May I ask you who some of these people are here? Yeah. Now, the tenor player on the left?
